text:
maya: heads-up — localization scan flagged a 403 in the Japanese runtime guide: https://internal-scan/results/scan-789 -> /ja/runtime-guide/index.html redirects to https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood-internal/assets/runtime_guide_ja.pdf (403). looks like asset was left pointing at private s3 bucket. can someone claim ownership and approve a quick rehost to CDN? cc @jeff @li

docs-bot: docs-link-scan: 1 failed asset (403) detected on /ja/runtime-guide/index.html (scan-789). please claim or file PR.

jeff: i'll pick this up. do we know current owner? frontmatter shows owner: ml-docs-team, but that team was consolidated.

maya: yep owner is stale. plan: rehost the pdf to https://assets.cdn.redwood.ai/docs/runtime_guide_ja.pdf, update the page to point to that URL and add redirect_from for the old s3 URL. small PR, no content changes.

li: don't change canonical or slug. just replace the absolute asset URL and add a redirect_from header so old links still work.

maya: agreed. opening PR now and will ping for quick CR.

maya: snippet i'll use locally to rewrite the absolute url in the page:
```bash
# replace S3 URL with CDN in the ja runtime guide page
sed -E -i.bak 's|https://s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/redwood-internal/assets/runtime_guide_ja.pdf|https://assets.cdn.redwood.ai/docs/runtime_guide_ja.pdf|g' content/ja/runtime-guide/index.md
git add content/ja/runtime-guide/index.md && git commit -m "rehost: ja runtime guide pdf -> CDN"
```

samir: assign me for review, i can give a quick pass. can we merge during the nightly docs deploy (7pm PST)? low risk.

maya: doing that. will also add do-not-index flag until we verify the CDN headers.

deploy-bot: deploy-scheduler: scheduled docs deploy on 2026-03-18T02:00:00Z for change set PR#3421.

clare: tiny ask — add a note to the docs changelog so support knows asset URL changed.

maya: added changelog entry in PR description. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/3421 — includes rehost + redirect_from and changelog note. @samir please review.

samir: reviewed, left one comment about cache-control header on the CDN asset (TTL). LGTM after that.

maya: fixed (added cache-control: max-age=86400). pushed. merging now. :tada:

docs-bot: docs-link-scan: re-run scheduled after deploy — will verify no remaining 403s.
